description: This file defines an interface (protocol) for connector classes to implement, providing a standard set of methods for interacting with external services such as search and create operations.

classes.name: BaseConnector
classes.description: An interface (protocol) that connector implementations should adhere to, defining methods for searching and creating resources on external systems.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] search(self, query: str, *, tenant_id: str, connection_id: str, **kwargs: Any)
methods.description: Asynchronously performs a search query on the external system, returning a list of result dictionaries.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create(self, payload: Dict[str, Any], *, tenant_id: str, connection_id: str, **kwargs: Any)
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new resource in the external system based on the provided payload, returning the created resource information.
